title: Left properness of Moore flows
summary: We introduce reparametrization categories with cuts. For every such category $\mathcal{P}$, the tensor product of two objectwise weak homotopy equivalences of $\mathcal{P}$-spaces is an objectwise weak homotopy equivalence, and the q-model structure on $\mathcal{P}$-flows is left proper. The reparametrization categories $\mathcal{G}$ and $\mathcal{M}$, as well as the terminal category $\mathbf{1}$, have cuts. The terminal category recovers the left properness of the q-model structure on ordinary flows. We also give a symmetric reparametrization category with cuts and a strict unit. This…
